name: MyUtil.not_and_or
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases Classical.em p with hp | hnp
    · exact Or.inr (fun hq => h (And.intro hp hq))
    · exact Or.inl hnp
  · intro hor ⟨hp, hq⟩
    rcases hor with h | h
    · exact h hp
    · exact h hq

end MyUtil

name: MyClassical.choose_spec
statement:
theorem choose_spec
    {α : Sort u}
    (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∃ x, p x) :
    p (choose p h)
context:
set_option linter.all false

universe u v

namespace MyClassical

noncomputable def choice
    {α : Sort u}
    (h : Nonempty α) :
    α :=
  Classical.choice h

noncomputable def indefiniteDescription
    {α : Sort u}
    (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∃ x, p x) :
    {x // p x} :=
  choice (let ⟨x, px⟩ := h; Nonempty.intro (Subtype.mk x px))

noncomputable def choose
    {α : Sort u}
    (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∃ x, p x) :
    α :=
  Subtype.val (indefiniteDescription p h)

name: MyClassical.em
context:
universe u v

namespace MyClassical

noncomputable def choice
    {α : Sort u}
    (h : Nonempty α) :
    α :=
  Classical.choice h

noncomputable def indefiniteDescription
    {α : Sort u}
    (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∃ x, p x) :
    {x // p x} :=
  choice (let ⟨x, px⟩ := h; Nonempty.intro (Subtype.mk x px))

noncomputable def choose
    {α : Sort u}
    (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∃ x, p x) :
    α :=
  Subtype.val (indefiniteDescription p h)

theorem choose_spec
    {α : Sort u}
    (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∃ x, p x) :
    p (choose p h) :=
  Subtype.property (indefiniteDescription p h)

name: MyClassical.byContradiction
proof:
:=
  Or.elim (Classical.em p) id (fun hnp => False.elim (h hnp))

end MyClassical
